name: How Rockets Work
summary: A conceptual introduction to rockets: action and reaction, thrust, propellants, staging and why reaching orbit is hard.

topics.name: Newton's third law and conservation of momentum: why rockets work in vacuum

Rocket anatomy: tanks, engines, nozzle, avionics, payload, fairing
How a nozzle turns heat into speed

From launch to orbit: vertical rise, gravity turn, orbital insertion
Famous rockets compared: V-2, Saturn V, Space Shuttle, Falcon 9, Starship
